summary: The leading/trailing bit-count methods returned zero when no opposite bit existed, instead of the homogeneous slice's length. The fix defaults to the slice length. This reversal isolates leading_zeros: an all-zero slice makes first_one return None, and unwrap_or_default incorrectly produces zero. The fix-added top-level integration test issue_next in tests/issues.rs checks a one-bit zero slice and expects one. No tests were executed.
